title: andira anthelmia
intro: Andira anthelmia, commonly known as the Brazilian rosewood or Andiroba, is a plant species native to the Amazon rainforest. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as reducing inflammation and pain relief, as well as exhibiting antimicrobial and antioxidant activities. The therapeutic actions of Andira anthelmia include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antiparasitic properties, making it useful in treating various conditions. The bioactive constituents of Andira anthelmia include andiroba oil, which contains fatty acids and other compounds such as triterpenes and flavonoids that contribute to its medicinal properties.
